name: TensorPM v1.38.2
body:
# Changelog - v1.38.2

This update improves sign-in reliability, keeps timeline progress visible while scrolling,
and includes the document and project-chat improvements added since v1.38.1.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Email verification and password resets now retain their confirmation details for the current
  session even if the system keyring refuses a write. Requesting a replacement code replaces
  the previous details, and expired codes are not restored from an older saved entry.
- The account menu keeps its warning visible when sign-in could not be saved, including after
  closing and reopening the menu. A successful save clears the warning.
- Category progress in the Gantt view remains visible during fast vertical scrolling.
- Closing the app no longer reports an artifact save failure when no document sessions need saving.

## 🔐 Sign-In Improvements

- Browser sign-in through passkeys, Google, and Apple is tied to the request started by the
  desktop app. Unexpected or duplicate callbacks cannot complete another sign-in request.
- Saved sign-in credentials require the system's secure storage. When secure storage is
  unavailable, you can still sign in for the current app session and see a clear explanation.
- Refresh retries retain their request identity, and email confirmation flows use the updated
  account-security protocol.

## 📝 Document and Project-Chat Improvements

- Continue work between a project conversation and a document conversation with the task and
  relevant context attached to the handover. Documents can accompany the return to project chat.
- The document agent can inspect rendered pages to check layout, including diagrams and page
  furniture, against the current document revision.
- Project-file references can be used in chat and code execution with checks that the referenced
  file still belongs to the project.
- Email drafts support project-file attachments. Approval retains the exact attachment snapshot
  that was reviewed before sending.
- OpenAI conversations handle follow-up instructions and parallel read operations more reliably.
- Updated AI-provider, synchronization, and email libraries; kept editor packages aligned.

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.38.2
- **Release Date**: 2026-09-15
- **Previous Version**: 1.38.1
- **Type**: Patch Release
